shortDescription: Retrieve IP geolocation and other facts of a host's IP address using the ipbase.com API

options.name: apikey
options.description: The API key for the request if you need more requests.

options.name: hostname
options.description: If the O(hostname) parameter is set to V(true), the API response contains the hostname of the IP.

options.name: ip
options.description: The IP you want to get the info for. If not specified the API detects the IP automatically.

options.name: language
options.description: An ISO Alpha 2 Language Code for localizing the IP data.
